meta.title: Cleansing Dawn
meta.description: Dreams become reality and the slumbering Sector is awoken once again, becoming the home of the Exiles.

units.rawText: ...Before we arrived at the Oasis, it seems that everyone had it quite rough, huh.
units.displayText: ...Before we arrived at the Oasis, it seems that everyone had it quite rough, huh.

spans.text: ...Before we arrived at the Oasis, it seems that everyone had it quite rough, huh.

units.rawText: Indeed, security and resource issues can be managed, but nothing cuts deeper than the helplessness of having no path forward.
units.displayText: Indeed, security and resource issues can be managed, but nothing cuts deeper than the helplessness of having no path forward.

spans.text: Indeed, security and resource issues can be managed, but nothing cuts deeper than the helplessness of having no path forward.

units.rawText: For us Dolls, our existence is hollow without human commands.
units.displayText: For us Dolls, our existence is hollow without human commands.

spans.text: For us Dolls, our existence is hollow without human commands.

units.rawText: In a situation like that, the Oasis is no more than a mirage. We don't know if we should approach it, let alone what awaits us beyond.
units.displayText: In a situation like that, the Oasis is no more than a mirage. We don't know if we should approach it, let alone what awaits us beyond.

spans.text: In a situation like that, the Oasis is no more than a mirage. We don't know if we should approach it, let alone what awaits us beyond.

units.rawText: Thanks to you, everyone's finally found their calm. You're our oasis—the reason the "Oasis" truly functions as one.
units.displayText: Thanks to you, everyone's finally found their calm. You're our oasis—the reason the "Oasis" truly functions as one.

spans.text: Thanks to you, everyone's finally found their calm. You're our oasis—the reason the "Oasis" truly functions as one.

units.rawText: (Cough) You flatter me.
units.displayText: (Cough) You flatter me.

spans.text: (Cough) You flatter me.

units.rawText: Persicaria's fiery gaze makes my face flush involuntarily. I cough awkwardly, breaking eye contact to cover my embarrassment.
units.displayText: Persicaria's fiery gaze makes my face flush involuntarily. I cough awkwardly, breaking eye contact to cover my embarrassment.

spans.text: Persicaria's fiery gaze makes my face flush involuntarily. I cough awkwardly, breaking eye contact to cover my embarrassment.

units.rawText: Professor, do you still remember what the Oasis was like originally?
units.displayText: Professor, do you still remember what the Oasis was like originally?

spans.text: Professor, do you still remember what the Oasis was like originally?

units.rawText: Persicaria retrieves a small, transparent bottle from her waist. The grass within is still lush and green, reflecting the tender care it's received.
units.displayText: Persicaria retrieves a small, transparent bottle from her waist. The grass within is still lush and green, reflecting the tender care it's received.

spans.text: Persicaria retrieves a small, transparent bottle from her waist. The grass within is still lush and green, reflecting the tender care it's received.

units.rawText: The Oasis must be a lush haven, a place where everyone lives happily, free from worries.
units.displayText: The Oasis must be a lush haven, a place where everyone lives happily, free from worries.

spans.text: The Oasis must be a lush haven, a place where everyone lives happily, free from worries.

units.rawText: Huh? Then let me take a small blade of grass, and see if the Oasis is really the way we imagined!
units.displayText: Huh? Then let me take a small blade of grass, and see if the Oasis is really the way we imagined!

spans.text: Huh? Then let me take a small blade of grass, and see if the Oasis is really the way we imagined!

units.rawText: The "Oasis" sets up too much hope and expectation just from the name itself.
units.displayText: The "Oasis" sets up too much hope and expectation just from the name itself.

spans.text: The "Oasis" sets up too much hope and expectation just from the name itself.

units.rawText: But that's also what allowed it to grow into what it is today—lively, lush, and brimming with both life and dreams.
units.displayText: But that's also what allowed it to grow into what it is today—lively, lush, and brimming with both life and dreams.

spans.text: But that's also what allowed it to grow into what it is today—lively, lush, and brimming with both life and dreams.

units.rawText: I see it... as a miracle, made possible by you and everyone's hard work.
units.displayText: I see it... as a miracle, made possible by you and everyone's hard work.

spans.text: I see it... as a miracle, made possible by you and everyone's hard work.

units.rawText: Persicaria, Persicaria! Are we getting close to the Oasis yet?
units.displayText: Persicaria, Persicaria! Are we getting close to the Oasis yet?

spans.text: Persicaria, Persicaria! Are we getting close to the Oasis yet?

units.rawText: Hmm, at this pace, we should arrive in about half a day.
units.displayText: Hmm, at this pace, we should arrive in about half a day.

spans.text: Hmm, at this pace, we should arrive in about half a day.

units.rawText: Awesome! Taking detours to dodge Sanctifiers, patching up wounds, and conserving energy—it's been rough on everyone, but soon it'll all be over once we refill our operands at the Oasis!
units.displayText: Awesome! Taking detours to dodge Sanctifiers, patching up wounds, and conserving energy—it's been rough on everyone, but soon it'll all be over once we refill our operands at the Oasis!

spans.text: Awesome! Taking detours to dodge Sanctifiers, patching up wounds, and conserving energy—it's been rough on everyone, but soon it'll all be over once we refill our operands at the Oasis!

units.rawText: ...You're right. Everything's gonna be okay.
units.displayText: ...You're right. Everything's gonna be okay.

spans.text: ...You're right. Everything's gonna be okay.

units.rawText: I notice the Professor speaking with Centaureissi not far from here. It seems like they're checking the supplies.
units.displayText: I notice the Professor speaking with Centaureissi not far from here. It seems like they're checking the supplies.

spans.text: I notice the Professor speaking with Centaureissi not far from here. It seems like they're checking the supplies.

units.rawText: Everyone seems more relaxed since the Professor came.
units.displayText: Everyone seems more relaxed since the Professor came.

spans.text: Everyone seems more relaxed since the Professor came.

units.rawText: They helped Simo and I gather information outside, and mapped out our path based on Sanctifiers' routes.
units.displayText: They helped Simo and I gather information outside, and mapped out our path based on Sanctifiers' routes.

spans.text: They helped Simo and I gather information outside, and mapped out our path based on Sanctifiers' routes.

units.rawText: They even talked about Metal Suit with Croque, and chatted about things I don't quite understand with Hubble and Fresnel...
units.displayText: They even talked about Metal Suit with Croque, and chatted about things I don't quite understand with Hubble and Fresnel...

spans.text: They even talked about Metal Suit with Croque, and chatted about things I don't quite understand with Hubble and Fresnel...

units.rawText: Hehe, it's only been a few days, but the Professor's already more than an acquaintance to everyone. They really know those who joined Project Neural Cloud well.
units.displayText: Hehe, it's only been a few days, but the Professor's already more than an acquaintance to everyone. They really know those who joined Project Neural Cloud well.

spans.text: Hehe, it's only been a few days, but the Professor's already more than an acquaintance to everyone. They really know those who joined Project Neural Cloud well.

units.rawText: Sol, what do you think of them?
units.displayText: Sol, what do you think of them?

spans.text: Sol, what do you think of them?

units.rawText: Think of what? Oh, you mean the Professor, Persicaria?
units.displayText: Think of what? Oh, you mean the Professor, Persicaria?

spans.text: Think of what? Oh, you mean the Professor, Persicaria?

units.rawText: Hmm... They still need to learn more about using operands, but overall I think they're quite dependable!
units.displayText: Hmm... They still need to learn more about using operands, but overall I think they're quite dependable!

spans.text: Hmm... They still need to learn more about using operands, but overall I think they're quite dependable!

units.rawText: ...I see.
units.displayText: ...I see.

spans.text: ...I see.

units.rawText: Once again, Sol's innocent smile keeps the truth locked inside me.
units.displayText: Once again, Sol's innocent smile keeps the truth locked inside me.

spans.text: Once again, Sol's innocent smile keeps the truth locked inside me.

units.rawText: The longer we spend time together, the more certain that they aren't the Professor Irida I know.
units.displayText: The longer we spend time together, the more certain that they aren't the Professor Irida I know.

spans.text: The longer we spend time together, the more certain that they aren't the Professor Irida I know.

units.rawText: The old me wouldn't hesitate to expose their disguise, questioning their true identity and purpose for all to see.
units.displayText: The old me wouldn't hesitate to expose their disguise, questioning their true identity and purpose for all to see.

spans.text: The old me wouldn't hesitate to expose their disguise, questioning their true identity and purpose for all to see.

units.rawText: But now, they have become the anchor holding everyone's hearts steady. How can I justify exposing their lies and making everyone face the truth?
units.displayText: But now, they have become the anchor holding everyone's hearts steady. How can I justify exposing their lies and making everyone face the truth?

spans.text: But now, they have become the anchor holding everyone's hearts steady. How can I justify exposing their lies and making everyone face the truth?

units.rawText: <size=28>What should I do...?</size>
units.displayText: What should I do...?

spans.text: What should I do...?

units.rawText: Persicaria? Are you okay? You look a little weary.
units.displayText: Persicaria? Are you okay? You look a little weary.

spans.text: Persicaria? Are you okay? You look a little weary.

units.rawText: ...I probably stayed up too late working yesterday. Sorry for making you worry.
units.displayText: ...I probably stayed up too late working yesterday. Sorry for making you worry.

spans.text: ...I probably stayed up too late working yesterday. Sorry for making you worry.

units.rawText: We've got the Professor here, you don't have to push yourself like that anymore, Persicaria.
units.displayText: We've got the Professor here, you don't have to push yourself like that anymore, Persicaria.

spans.text: We've got the Professor here, you don't have to push yourself like that anymore, Persicaria.

units.rawText: Look at those dark circles under your eyes, heck, your face is as pale as paper. You haven't been resting properly for days, have you?
units.displayText: Look at those dark circles under your eyes, heck, your face is as pale as paper. You haven't been resting properly for days, have you?

spans.text: Look at those dark circles under your eyes, heck, your face is as pale as paper. You haven't been resting properly for days, have you?

units.rawText: I had a lot of work to do...
units.displayText: I had a lot of work to do...

spans.text: I had a lot of work to do...

units.rawText: Sigh. With eye bags that dark, you'd look exactly like Dr. Persica if you borrowed her clothes.
units.displayText: Sigh. With eye bags that dark, you'd look exactly like Dr. Persica if you borrowed her clothes.

spans.text: Sigh. With eye bags that dark, you'd look exactly like Dr. Persica if you borrowed her clothes.

units.rawText: Yeah... If it were the Doctor standing here instead of me, things might have turned out better.
units.displayText: Yeah... If it were the Doctor standing here instead of me, things might have turned out better.

spans.text: Yeah... If it were the Doctor standing here instead of me, things might have turned out better.

units.rawText: I doubt it. The Doctor I know wouldn't work through all of that with such diligence.
units.displayText: I doubt it. The Doctor I know wouldn't work through all of that with such diligence.

spans.text: I doubt it. The Doctor I know wouldn't work through all of that with such diligence.

units.rawText: Eh?
units.displayText: Eh?

spans.text: Eh?

units.rawText: The unexpected voice startles me. I turn to find a familiar figure—the Professor, now walking beside me, meeting my gaze with a serious expression.
units.displayText: The unexpected voice startles me. I turn to find a familiar figure—the Professor, now walking beside me, meeting my gaze with a serious expression.

spans.text: The unexpected voice startles me. I turn to find a familiar figure—the Professor, now walking beside me, meeting my gaze with a serious expression.

units.rawText: You don't need to be like the Doctor, Persicaria. You only need to be you.
units.displayText: You don't need to be like the Doctor, Persicaria. You only need to be you.

spans.text: You don't need to be like the Doctor, Persicaria. You only need to be you.

units.rawText: ...Okay.
units.displayText: ...Okay.

spans.text: ...Okay.

units.rawText: Professor, have you finished checking the supplies?
units.displayText: Professor, have you finished checking the supplies?

spans.text: Professor, have you finished checking the supplies?

units.rawText: Mm-hmm. We don't have much left. Hopefully we can restock at the Oasis.
units.displayText: Mm-hmm. We don't have much left. Hopefully we can restock at the Oasis.

spans.text: Mm-hmm. We don't have much left. Hopefully we can restock at the Oasis.

units.rawText: Ah...
units.displayText: Ah...

spans.text: Ah...

units.rawText: My head drops, weighed down by doubt. The Professor, as if noticing, pats my shoulder.
units.displayText: My head drops, weighed down by doubt. The Professor, as if noticing, pats my shoulder.

spans.text: My head drops, weighed down by doubt. The Professor, as if noticing, pats my shoulder.

units.rawText: Speaking of which, I'd like to investigate the Oasis before we mobilize everyone. Would you come with me, Persicaria?
units.displayText: Speaking of which, I'd like to investigate the Oasis before we mobilize everyone. Would you come with me, Persicaria?

spans.text: Speaking of which, I'd like to investigate the Oasis before we mobilize everyone. Would you come with me, Persicaria?

units.rawText: The injured need more time to rest. We can use this opportunity to assess the Oasis' condition and ensure it's secure before relocating everyone.
units.displayText: The injured need more time to rest. We can use this opportunity to assess the Oasis' condition and ensure it's secure before relocating everyone.

spans.text: The injured need more time to rest. We can use this opportunity to assess the Oasis' condition and ensure it's secure before relocating everyone.

units.rawText: What about me? Count me in! It's safer to have a combatant with you.
units.displayText: What about me? Count me in! It's safer to have a combatant with you.

spans.text: What about me? Count me in! It's safer to have a combatant with you.

units.rawText: Heh, I've scouted ahead and there'll be no danger on the road. The injured here need your protection more than us. I need you here to protect everyone else.
units.displayText: Heh, I've scouted ahead and there'll be no danger on the road. The injured here need your protection more than us. I need you here to protect everyone else.

spans.text: Heh, I've scouted ahead and there'll be no danger on the road. The injured here need your protection more than us. I need you here to protect everyone else.

units.rawText: Sure, you can count on me for that! I'll check on the others right away.
units.displayText: Sure, you can count on me for that! I'll check on the others right away.

spans.text: Sure, you can count on me for that! I'll check on the others right away.

units.rawText: Sol sheathes her longsword, gives me a reassuring thumbs-up, and walks away.
units.displayText: Sol sheathes her longsword, gives me a reassuring thumbs-up, and walks away.

spans.text: Sol sheathes her longsword, gives me a reassuring thumbs-up, and walks away.

units.rawText: ...So you're also worried about the Oasis' condition.
units.displayText: ...So you're also worried about the Oasis' condition.

spans.text: ...So you're also worried about the Oasis' condition.

units.rawText: Your doubts from earlier brought it to mind. It's been quite long, and the Oasis may have changed as time has gone by, and perhaps it no longer has the resources to be a secure base.
units.displayText: Your doubts from earlier brought it to mind. It's been quite long, and the Oasis may have changed as time has gone by, and perhaps it no longer has the resources to be a secure base.

spans.text: Your doubts from earlier brought it to mind. It's been quite long, and the Oasis may have changed as time has gone by, and perhaps it no longer has the resources to be a secure base.

units.rawText: So let's get going, Persicaria. We'll first go to the Oasis and check on things there.
units.displayText: So let's get going, Persicaria. We'll first go to the Oasis and check on things there.

spans.text: So let's get going, Persicaria. We'll first go to the Oasis and check on things there.

units.rawText: It doesn't take long for us to arrive at the Oasis. A vast, dormant sector looms ahead, as if concealing an unknown destiny.
units.displayText: It doesn't take long for us to arrive at the Oasis. A vast, dormant sector looms ahead, as if concealing an unknown destiny.

spans.text: It doesn't take long for us to arrive at the Oasis. A vast, dormant sector looms ahead, as if concealing an unknown destiny.

units.rawText: So this is the Oasis...
units.displayText: So this is the Oasis...

spans.text: So this is the Oasis...

units.rawText: Are you watching, Knot...? We're finally here.
units.displayText: Are you watching, Knot...? We're finally here.

spans.text: Are you watching, Knot...? We're finally here.

units.rawText: Persicaria...
units.displayText: Persicaria...

spans.text: Persicaria...

units.rawText: ...I'm fine.
units.displayText: ...I'm fine.

spans.text: ...I'm fine.

units.rawText: It's time we assess the current state of the Oasis, Professor.
units.displayText: It's time we assess the current state of the Oasis, Professor.

spans.text: It's time we assess the current state of the Oasis, Professor.

units.rawText: Right. Let's head right on in. Uh... activating it requires some access privileges, it seems.
units.displayText: Right. Let's head right on in. Uh... activating it requires some access privileges, it seems.

spans.text: Right. Let's head right on in. Uh... activating it requires some access privileges, it seems.

units.rawText: ...Let me do it.
units.displayText: ...Let me do it.

spans.text: ...Let me do it.

units.rawText: The sector slowly unlocks itself. It should be a most fortuitous affair, yet all my heart does is race.
units.displayText: The sector slowly unlocks itself. It should be a most fortuitous affair, yet all my heart does is race.

spans.text: The sector slowly unlocks itself. It should be a most fortuitous affair, yet all my heart does is race.

units.rawText: The state of the Oasis will, more or less, determine our fate from here on out. I can only hope that Professor Irida prepared enough operands, reference materials, and even contingencies—like ways to return to reality, alternative passages, and—
units.displayText: The state of the Oasis will, more or less, determine our fate from here on out. I can only hope that Professor Irida prepared enough operands, reference materials, and even contingencies—like ways to return to reality, alternative passages, and—

spans.text: The state of the Oasis will, more or less, determine our fate from here on out. I can only hope that Professor Irida prepared enough operands, reference materials, and even contingencies—like ways to return to reality, alternative passages, and—

units.rawText: Beep.
units.displayText: Beep.

spans.text: Beep.

units.rawText: With the firewall's short beep, the answer to our destiny henceforth comes into view.
units.displayText: With the firewall's short beep, the answer to our destiny henceforth comes into view.

spans.text: With the firewall's short beep, the answer to our destiny henceforth comes into view.

units.rawText: What greets us... is nothing.
units.displayText: What greets us... is nothing.

spans.text: What greets us... is nothing.

units.rawText: Resources, research references, Agents… All data has been mercilessly wiped, leaving behind only blank spaces and floating data blocks—the hollow remnants of what once existed.
units.displayText: Resources, research references, Agents… All data has been mercilessly wiped, leaving behind only blank spaces and floating data blocks—the hollow remnants of what once existed.

spans.text: Resources, research references, Agents… All data has been mercilessly wiped, leaving behind only blank spaces and floating data blocks—the hollow remnants of what once existed.

units.rawText: Dazed and disoriented, I summon the last of my willpower to search desperately for any surviving data in the sector—a final grasp at a sliver of hope.
units.displayText: Dazed and disoriented, I summon the last of my willpower to search desperately for any surviving data in the sector—a final grasp at a sliver of hope.

spans.text: Dazed and disoriented, I summon the last of my willpower to search desperately for any surviving data in the sector—a final grasp at a sliver of hope.

units.displayText: [Total Data in Sector: 0]

units.rawText: I freeze in front of the screen, staring blankly until the cold number begins to distort, error sounds echoing from the system.
units.displayText: I freeze in front of the screen, staring blankly until the cold number begins to distort, error sounds echoing from the system.

spans.text: I freeze in front of the screen, staring blankly until the cold number begins to distort, error sounds echoing from the system.

units.rawText: ...The hope we clung to so stubbornly has been proven false, and nothing but a shattered dream stands before us. The wonderland we yearned for so long reveals itself to be nothing more than a castle in the sky.
units.displayText: ...The hope we clung to so stubbornly has been proven false, and nothing but a shattered dream stands before us. The wonderland we yearned for so long reveals itself to be nothing more than a castle in the sky.

spans.text: ...The hope we clung to so stubbornly has been proven false, and nothing but a shattered dream stands before us. The wonderland we yearned for so long reveals itself to be nothing more than a castle in the sky.

units.rawText: How... Why, why did it turn out like this...? Knot's sacrifice... it should have been for a cause, much greater than this...
units.displayText: How... Why, why did it turn out like this...? Knot's sacrifice... it should have been for a cause, much greater than this...

spans.text: How... Why, why did it turn out like this...? Knot's sacrifice... it should have been for a cause, much greater than this...

units.rawText: This is what we've been chasing after? What are we supposed to do next? How can I even begin to tell the others?
units.displayText: This is what we've been chasing after? What are we supposed to do next? How can I even begin to tell the others?

spans.text: This is what we've been chasing after? What are we supposed to do next? How can I even begin to tell the others?

units.rawText: Did I make the wrong decision once more? I...
units.displayText: Did I make the wrong decision once more? I...

spans.text: Did I make the wrong decision once more? I...

units.rawText: ...Persicaria! Persicaria! Are you listening?
units.displayText: ...Persicaria! Persicaria! Are you listening?

spans.text: ...Persicaria! Persicaria! Are you listening?

units.rawText: Pro...fessor?
units.displayText: Pro...fessor?

spans.text: Pro...fessor?

units.rawText: Where do you think we should set up headquarters? Should it be closer to the dorms or near the engineering department?
units.displayText: Where do you think we should set up headquarters? Should it be closer to the dorms or near the engineering department?

spans.text: Where do you think we should set up headquarters? Should it be closer to the dorms or near the engineering department?

units.rawText: Eh?
units.displayText: Eh?

spans.text: Eh?

units.rawText: What? Were you not listening to me? Fine, I'll explain my reconstruction plan to you again.
units.displayText: What? Were you not listening to me? Fine, I'll explain my reconstruction plan to you again.

spans.text: What? Were you not listening to me? Fine, I'll explain my reconstruction plan to you again.

units.rawText: ...How?
units.displayText: ...How?

spans.text: ...How?

units.rawText: As the Professor stands totally unfazed, the question lingering in my heart spills out naturally.
units.displayText: As the Professor stands totally unfazed, the question lingering in my heart spills out naturally.

spans.text: As the Professor stands totally unfazed, the question lingering in my heart spills out naturally.

units.rawText: There's nothing. No resources, no references... Everything you mentioned doesn't even exist.
units.displayText: There's nothing. No resources, no references... Everything you mentioned doesn't even exist.

spans.text: There's nothing. No resources, no references... Everything you mentioned doesn't even exist.

units.rawText: How could you even begin to act like this...
units.displayText: How could you even begin to act like this...

spans.text: How could you even begin to act like this...

units.rawText: Everything will be there.
units.displayText: Everything will be there.

spans.text: Everything will be there.

units.rawText: The Professor speaks with confidence and determination, as if it's simply a matter of fact.
units.displayText: The Professor speaks with confidence and determination, as if it's simply a matter of fact.

spans.text: The Professor speaks with confidence and determination, as if it's simply a matter of fact.

units.rawText: But the things you mentioned will require operands we don't have...
units.displayText: But the things you mentioned will require operands we don't have...

spans.text: But the things you mentioned will require operands we don't have...

units.rawText: We can head out and gather more resources, just like we did before. I'll join the field team to scout the area and mark resource deposits. That way, we can establish a stable process for acquiring operands.
units.displayText: We can head out and gather more resources, just like we did before. I'll join the field team to scout the area and mark resource deposits. That way, we can establish a stable process for acquiring operands.

spans.text: We can head out and gather more resources, just like we did before. I'll join the field team to scout the area and mark resource deposits. That way, we can establish a stable process for acquiring operands.

units.rawText: But we still need to deal with the threats posed by the Sanctifiers...
units.displayText: But we still need to deal with the threats posed by the Sanctifiers...

spans.text: But we still need to deal with the threats posed by the Sanctifiers...

units.rawText: The firewall we just inspected is fully operational, a clear indication that our safety within the sector is ensured.
units.displayText: The firewall we just inspected is fully operational, a clear indication that our safety within the sector is ensured.

spans.text: The firewall we just inspected is fully operational, a clear indication that our safety within the sector is ensured.

units.rawText: As for the fieldwork, I'll analyze the Sanctifiers' routes and behaviors based on our data, so we can chart a path that avoids them.
units.displayText: As for the fieldwork, I'll analyze the Sanctifiers' routes and behaviors based on our data, so we can chart a path that avoids them.

spans.text: As for the fieldwork, I'll analyze the Sanctifiers' routes and behaviors based on our data, so we can chart a path that avoids them.

units.rawText: But in the end, we still don't have a way to go back to reality...
units.displayText: But in the end, we still don't have a way to go back to reality...

spans.text: But in the end, we still don't have a way to go back to reality...

units.rawText: Then let's do our own research, find our own way. We've been working towards Project Neural Cloud for a while now, haven't we?
units.displayText: Then let's do our own research, find our own way. We've been working towards Project Neural Cloud for a while now, haven't we?

spans.text: Then let's do our own research, find our own way. We've been working towards Project Neural Cloud for a while now, haven't we?

units.rawText: Like I said, I'll bring everyone back to reality.
units.displayText: Like I said, I'll bring everyone back to reality.

spans.text: Like I said, I'll bring everyone back to reality.

units.rawText: The resolve in the Professor's eyes convinces me that they've envisioned that future with a clarity beyond me.
units.displayText: The resolve in the Professor's eyes convinces me that they've envisioned that future with a clarity beyond me.

spans.text: The resolve in the Professor's eyes convinces me that they've envisioned that future with a clarity beyond me.

units.rawText: It may not be the "Oasis" we had in mind, but it's still a significant improvement over any camp we've stayed in before.
units.displayText: It may not be the "Oasis" we had in mind, but it's still a significant improvement over any camp we've stayed in before.

spans.text: It may not be the "Oasis" we had in mind, but it's still a significant improvement over any camp we've stayed in before.

units.rawText: More importantly, we get to make our own Oasis, one that's all ours. Doesn't that sound great?
